result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It states one thing: TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development builds included, with no exception for dev. It also notes the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere, with no exceptions.

Both statements come from the project's recorded decisions (#22 and #25). I left out the older decision that had disabled verification in dev builds, since #22 replaced it.

My first attempt at writing the file failed with a shell parse error, so I created it with the Write tool instead. I did not re-read the file after writing it.

Muninn's session-start heartbeat also flagged 20 hook runs that started and never finished. I didn't investigate it; the log is `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`.
